{{Quote|The subjugation of Parrlay is just the beginning of our invasion.|Nute Gunray, to Darth Sidious|audio=ParrlayBeginning.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''subjugation of Parrlay''', also known as the '''destruction of Parrlay''', was one of the first battles of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Trade Federation launched a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in protest of the taxation of [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zones]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In preparation for a full-scale invasion of the planet, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] sent a [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] force [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] to eliminate the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo's]] capacity for offworld communications.

OOM-9 approached the [[City/Legends|city]] [[New Centrif]] first but turned his attention to the nearby city [[Vis/Legends|Vis]] after finding New Centrif to be too well-defended. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] razed Vis and its [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] with the help of reinforcements commanded by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[EEK-176]]. Afterward, the strengthened droid force marched on New Centrif and destroyed its transmitter. The droids then turned toward [[Parrlay]], the city that held the last transmitter, and were helped by more reinforcements from Gunray as they destroyed the Parrlayan transmitter, as well. The destruction of the communications technology was immediately noticed in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], where a conversation between [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of Naboo and an offworld [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was interrupted.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Do you think she suspects an attack?''"<br />"''I don't know, but we must move quickly to disrupt all communications down there.|Rune Haako and Nute Gunray, following a transmission with Queen Amidala|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in response to [[Senate Resolution BR-0371]], a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] ruling that placed a tariff on [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zones]].<ref name="GB" /> The blockade was orchestrated by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], whose public identity was that of Naboo's [[Senator/Legends|senator]] Palpatine.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> In preparation for an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]], the Trade Federation executed several covert operations to block Naboo's communications, including the [[Attack on the Kwilaan sensor array|disabling]] of a [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]] in order to allow [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] to be placed undetected.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20010809a|text=Signal Interruption|int=Signal Interruption}}</ref> Following a failed [[Mission to Naboo|ambush]] on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] sent to resolve the blockade, Sidious ordered [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to begin landing the Federation's [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] on the planet.<ref name="TPM" /> The Sith Lord gave the Trade Federation two primary objectives, the first being to block Naboo's ability to communicate with the Senate, and the second to capture Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] and force her to sign a treaty of surrender.<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

[[File:TheParrlaycrew.png|thumb|right|280px|OOM-9 with his initial forces]]
Following a hostile conversation via transmission with Amidala, Gunray's<ref name="TPM" /> legal [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] asked him if the queen suspected an attack, to which Gunray responded that he was unsure if she did but knew that they had to move to disrupt the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo's]] ability to report the invasion<ref name="TPM" /> to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. To that end, Gunray delegated to the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] the responsibility of destroying three [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] in the Naboo cities of [[New Centrif]], [[Vis/Legends|Vis]], and [[Parrlay]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] landed north of New Centrif aboard a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] with a force that included his personal [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Heavy Armored Assault Tank]], eight B1-Series [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], four heavy [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]], and two [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]].<ref name="GB" />

==The subjugation==
{{Quote|OOM-9, we are commencing flanking maneuvers on the Naboo.|EEK-176|audio=EEK-176.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The Droid Army approached New Centrif first, but OOM-9 observed that the city was too well-defended and would require reinforcements to attack. He directed his battle droids to Vis, a short distance east of New Centrif. Upon their arrival, Gunray dispatched another force [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the B1 battle droid [[EEK-176]], which included three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], four heavy [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] droids, and four B1 battle droids. EEK-176's forces flanked Vis from the south while OOM-9's forces entered from the west. The droids [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] there, which included four [[Security Guard/Legends|royal troopers]], nine [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] recruits, a [[V-19 landspeeder]],<ref name="GB" /> and four [[Tuskcat Trooper]]s.<ref name="CC" /> Afterward, they destroyed the rest of the city and its transmitter,<ref name="Prima" /> and EEK-176 declared the capture of Vis.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:New_Centrif_attack.png|thumb|left|300px|New Centrif under attack]]
OOM-9 marched the Droid Army toward New Centrif next, accessing it through its southern entrance rather than the more heavily defended north. The Federation force killed a group containing three trooper recruits and one [[Monarchy/Legends|royal]] trooper on the path before entering the city, where it eliminated five [[PKN-49 worker droid]]s, who were gathering [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]]<ref name="Prima" /> and working as [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]<ref name="GB" /> there, as well as their defenders. Subsequently, the vast majority of New Centrif's population,<ref name="Prima" /> which included ten troopers, three trooper recruits,<ref name="GB" /> six Tuskcat Troopers,<ref name="CC" /> and three V-19 [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]],<ref name="GB" /> descended on the invaders. OOM-9 kept his beetle droids in reserve while gunning down the Naboo, with his forces suffering minimal casualties in the process. Afterward, OOM-9 sent his droids further into the city to clear out any stragglers and used the beetle droids to [[Fire/Legends|burn]] New Centrif and its transmitter to the ground.<ref name="Prima" /> EEK-176 then declared the outcome again.<ref name="GB" />

The droids encountered and dispatched two separate groups of three Parrlayan royal troopers on the road leading to the last transmitter. As OOM-9's [[Army/Legends|army]] entered Parrlay, Gunray sent another [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] to reinforce the droids from the north of the city: two heavy beetle droids, two droidekas, two [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], and three [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]].<ref name="GB" /> The combined droid forces pressed through Parrlay's defenders,<ref name="Prima" /> which included ten royal troopers,<ref name="GB" /> seven Tuskcat Troopers,<ref name="CC" /> four V-19 landspeeders, and two [[Champion (vehicle)|champion]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]].<ref name="GB" /> They eventually reached the walled area of Parrlay that contained the transmitter. A [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] was located behind the wall, from which royal troopers began emerging. OOM-9 placed his battle droids along the wall in order to open fire on the troopers while his beetle droids burned through the wall and destroyed the transmitter, completing the destruction of Parrlay.<ref name="Prima" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|A communications disruption can mean only one thing—invasion.|Sio Bibble|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:Communications_disruption.png|thumb|right|350px|A meeting between Palpatine and the Royal Naboo Advisory was disrupted by the Trade Federation.]]
The destruction of the transmitters allowed the Trade Federation to continue the invasion without alerting the Galactic Republic. Gunray reported the subjugation of Parrlay to Sidious, acknowledging that it was merely the beginning of the invasion.<ref name="GB" /> At the time of the communications disruption, Queen Amidala and the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] were in Naboo's capital [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], in a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] meeting with Palpatine, who was offworld. Palpatine's hologram was cut off unexpectedly,<ref name="TPM" /> leading Royal Naboo Security Forces [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] to speculate that the Trade Federation was jamming their communications,<ref name="Junior">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' junior novelization]]</ref> while [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] concluded that an invasion had begun.<ref name="TPM" /> OOM-9 [[Capture of Harte Secur|proceeded to]] [[Invasion of Spinnaker|conquer]] the Naboo cities of [[Harte Secur]] and [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]],<ref name="GB" /> and [[Capture of Theed/Legends|captured]] Theed the morning after the Army had landed on the planet.<ref name="Inside" /> The Royal Advisory Council peacefully surrendered to the Trade Federation, at which point Bibble chastized Gunray for interrupting their communications with Palpatine while arguments were still underway in the Senate.<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>

During the Fall of Theed, the Jedi ambassadors [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] snuck into Theed to rescue Amidala from her droid captors, planning to make contact with the Republic and report the invasion. When strategizing with the rest of the queen's entourage, Panaka responded that their communications were still disrupted, leading the Jedi to decide on acquiring [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|transportation]] offworld in order to allow Amidala to share word of Naboo's strife with the Galactic Senate.<ref name="TPM" /> OOM-9 was credited for destroying the communications capabilities of New Centrif and Vis, of which word later reached Sidious's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="End Game">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> In an interview eventually recorded in the [[Royal Archives of Naboo, Vol. 2453]], Royal Naboo Security Forces veteran [[Pars Varqom]] recalled the loss of communications as marking the beginning of the invasion.<ref name="Warfare">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We must alert Parrlay!|A Naboo trooper in unused audio from ''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds''|audio=ParrlayAlert.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Trade_Federation_campaign.png|thumb|right|250px|The subjugation of Parrlay was portrayed in the first level of the Trade Federation campaign in ''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds''.]]
The disruption of Naboo's communications was created for the plot of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="TPM" /> The event was first mentioned in the film's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Terry Brooks]],<ref name="TPM novel" /> released on [[April 21]], [[1999]], before the film's premiere on [[May 19]] of that year.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> In the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', the events concerning the disruption were depicted as a battle in the first level of the Trade Federation campaign, "Beachhead." The battle's name was given in the introductory cutscene of the following level, "Behind the Lines." Unused audio files from the game depict an attack by the droid [[OOM-14/Legends|OOM-14]] on the city [[Pontel]] and a Naboo trooper declaring that Parrlay has to be warned of the upcoming attack.<ref name="GB" /> The accompanying [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]] describes several differences in the subjugation's portrayal from the finished game. It depicts [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]],<ref name="Prima" /> rather than transmitters,<ref name="GB" /> as the targets in each city. The guide also states that the player would receive two droidekas when attacking Vis,<ref name="Prima" /> while in the game, the player instead receives three.<ref name="GB" />

In the original version of ''Galactic Battlegrounds'', the Naboo mounted troopers rode [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]];<ref name="GB" /> they were changed to [[tusk cat]]s in the [[2002]] expansion [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].<ref name="CC" /> The number of enemy units faced by the player in ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' changes depending on the difficulty level. In Vis, the four royal troopers and the V-19 landspeeder are only present in hard difficulty. The [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] at the entrance to New Centrif are not present in easy difficulty, and three royal troopers and two landspeeders are added in hard difficulty. On easy mode in Parrlay, there are three fewer troopers, two fewer V-19 landspeeders, and one less turret, and royal troopers do not spawn from the southern troop center. All of those units, aside from the initial three troopers, appear in medium and hard difficulty.<ref name="GB" /> This article follows the units portrayed in hard difficulty.
